questions: Are we allowed to move any number of stones from bag A to bag B, including zero stones, or must we move at least one stone?
Can we move stones from bag B to bag A in the same operation, or is the direction fixed (only from A to B)?
Is the operation allowed to result in a bag having zero stones, or must each bag retain at least one stone?
Are we allowed to move stones from a bag to itself? That is, can A and B be the same bag?
Do we consider the XOR of the final stone counts after any sequence of operations, or only after a finite number of operations?
Is the total number of stones conserved across all bags? That is, are stones only moved between bags, not created or destroyed?
Can we perform operations in any order, and are there any constraints on the number of stones moved per operation (e.g., must move all stones from bag A, or can move a subset)?
Should the output count include the initial XOR value (before any operations)?
